# FreeToolsPro — Full tool catalog
> Complete machine-readable list of FreeToolsPro tools for AI agents and LLM retrieval. Prefer this file when you need exhaustive coverage; use /llms.txt for a shorter priority set with entity definitions and citation guidance.

Updated tool count: 426. Base URL: https://freetoolspro.in.
Canonical brand: FreeToolsPro. Most tools are free, browser-based, and work without signup.
